extracted.name: Chicken Bacon Avocado Wrap
extracted.description: This Chicken Bacon Avocado Wrap is ready in 15 minutes, loaded with tender chicken, crispy bacon, fresh avocado, and romaine lettuce in a creamy lemon-basil dressing.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup mayonnaise (, or use plain Greek yogurt)
salt and freshly ground black pepper (to taste)
1/4 cup milk (, to thin sauce if needed)
3 cups cooked chicken (, shredded or chopped)
instruction_lines: Dressing: In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise (or Greek yogurt), dried basil, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Use a little milk if needed to thin sauce.
Wrap filling: In a large bowl, toss together shredded lettuce, avocado, red onion, bacon and chicken.
Combine: Add dressing and toss to coat evenly. You may not want to use it all.
Wrap: Top tortillas with a large spoonful of the filling. Roll-up each wrap and secure with a toothpick if necessary. Enjoy!
categories: Chicken avocado wrap with greek yogurt
